> 第15章 紫霄神雷（第1页）
当务之急就是要把红云老祖找出来击杀掉，大阵不攻自破。
奈何这红云老祖狡诈无比，身体躲在大阵深处根本就不现身，这可如何是好。
陈长生不说话操控覆地印对那些魂幡砸下，就算杀不了红云老祖，只要毁坏一两把血魂幡，大阵必然会出现缺口，他就好趁机逃走。
不过那些血魂幡不断跳跃，变换位置，隐藏在红雾之中，想要砸到它们的本体哪里有那么容易。
红云老祖乃是万年老妖，狡诈无比，怎么会犯下这种低级错误。
“哼，红云老祖，有本事你现身与我一战，躲在暗处像个缩头乌龟算是什么本事。”
陈长生把覆地印祭在头顶，眼神警惕的看着四周，只要红发老祖出现，立即就给他一下子。
他已经看出来这红云老祖乃是一元灵之体，应该经不起覆地印来砸。
“桀桀桀，小子，少来这一套，老祖吃过的盐比你吃的饭都多，岂会上你的当！”
红云老祖声音忽东忽西，飘忽不定，根本不知道他躲藏在什么地方。
陈长生把覆地印缩小成一间房屋大小，守护着自己的肉身，这样他可以坚持的时间长些。
他心中郁闷，本来自己法宝大成，如果对付一般的炼气期修士根本就是手到擒来，可没想到遇到的是红云老祖这样的万年老妖。
现在大阵破不了，等自己体内的混沌之气耗尽，覆地印没法施展出来，只怕就是自己的末日。
很快，覆地印越变越小，到最后只有一平方大小，上面的金光黯淡了不少，很显然是体内的灵力支撑不住了。
血魂大阵则趁机缩小，压缩陈长生的空间。
随着时间的推移，最终覆地印“嗖”的一声变成一道金光缩进陈长生的体内。
在桀桀桀怪笑当中，红云老祖终于现身出来，“小子，油尽灯枯了吧，乖乖给老祖祭旗吧！”
陈长生大袖一抖，只见一片紫光朝红云当头笼罩下来。

顿时一片紫色光芒夹杂着雷声滚滚，拇指粗细的闪电，拳头大的黑色阴雷，当头爆炸开来。
这正是陈长生得自丧德彪的那张紫霄神雷符，本来他舍不得用，但现在眼看不用是不行了。
“该死的！你怎么会有这个东西！”
红云老祖面色大变，他乃是元灵之体，最怕雷属性的攻击，要是被轰一下，恐怕落得个魂飞魄散的下场。
情急之下，红云老祖一掐法诀，顿时那些血魂幡猛的一个塌缩，汇聚成了一件血红色的铠甲穿在他的身上。
剧烈的爆炸之后，红云老祖显出身来，此刻他显得有些狼狈，身上那些血魂幡化作的铠甲被炸的破破烂烂，头发被烧焦。
整个身体变得虚幻了不少，再无之前的意气风发。
他的血魂幡被炸的破破烂烂，里面的魂魄死伤大半，剩下的都跑光了。
陈长生见紫霄神雷符都没有炸死红云老祖，顿时脸色难看，这个千年老妖还真的是难缠。

After being demoted to the alchemy room, I secretly became invincible. The latest chapter_Chapter 15 Purple Sky Divine Thunder Page 1_After being demoted to the alchemy room, I secretly became invincible to a green lotus_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 15 Purple Sky Divine Thunder (Page 1)
The top priority is to find Patriarch Hongyun and kill him so that the formation will collapse without attack.
However, this ancestor of Hongyun is so cunning that he hides his body deep in the formation and does not show up at all. What should he do?
Chen Changsheng said nothing and controlled the earth-covering seal to hit the soul flags. Even if he couldn't kill the Hongyun ancestor, as long as he destroyed one or two blood soul flags, there would be a gap in the formation, and he could take the opportunity to escape.
However, those blood soul flags kept jumping, changing positions, and hiding in the red mist. It was not that easy to hit their bodies.
Ancestor Hongyun is a ten-thousand-year-old monster and extremely cunning. How could he make such a low-level mistake?
"Huh, Ancestor Hongyun, if you have the ability, you can show up and fight with me. How can you hide in the dark like a shrunken turtle?"
Chen Changsheng placed the earth-covering seal on his head and looked around with vigilant eyes. As soon as the red-haired ancestor appeared, he would immediately give him a blow.
He has already seen that the Hongyun Ancestor is a body of one soul and should not be able to withstand the Earth-Overturning Seal.
"Jie, Jie, Jie, boy, don't do this! My ancestor has eaten more salt than you have eaten, so how can I be fooled by you!"
Ancestor Hongyun's voice fluctuated from east to west, erratically, and it was impossible to tell where he was hiding.
Chen Changsheng reduced the earth-covering seal to the size of a house to protect his physical body so that he could last longer.
He was depressed in his heart. If he had mastered the magic weapon, he would be able to deal with ordinary monks in the Qi Refining Stage. However, he did not expect to encounter a ten thousand year old monster like Patriarch Hongyun.
Now that the formation cannot be broken, when the energy of chaos in his body is exhausted and the earth-covering seal cannot be used, I am afraid it will be his own doom.
Soon, the ground-covering seal became smaller and smaller, until it was only one square meter in size, and the golden light on it dimmed a lot. It was obvious that the spiritual power in the body could no longer support it.
The Blood Soul Formation took the opportunity to shrink, compressing Chen Changsheng's space.
As time went by, the ground-covering seal finally turned into a golden light and retracted into Chen Changsheng's body with a "whoosh" sound.
In the midst of Jiejiejie's strange laughter, Ancestor Hongyun finally appeared, "Boy, the oil has run out and the lamp has dried up. Obediently offer a flag to the ancestor!"
Chen Changsheng shook his sleeves, and saw a purple light shrouding Hongyun's head.
Suddenly, a purple light mixed with thunder rolled, lightning as thick as a thumb, and black thunder as big as a fist exploded in front of the head.
This was the Zixiao Divine Thunder Talisman that Chen Changsheng got from Sang Debiao. He was reluctant to use it at first, but now he can no longer use it.
"Damn it! Why do you have this thing!"
Ancestor Hongyun's expression changed drastically. He was a spirit body and was most afraid of thunder-type attacks. If he was hit, he would probably end up in a state of disarray.
In desperation, Patriarch Hongyun made a magic move, and the blood soul flags suddenly collapsed, converging into a blood-red armor and wearing it on his body.
After the violent explosion, Ancestor Hongyun appeared. He looked a little embarrassed at the moment. The armor turned into blood soul flags was blown to tatters, and his hair was burnt.
The whole body has become a lot more unreal, and it no longer has the high spirits it had before.
His Blood Soul Flag was blown to pieces, most of the souls inside were killed and injured, and the rest were all gone.
When Chen Changsheng saw that the Purple Sky Divine Thunder Talisman did not kill the Hongyun Ancestor, his face suddenly turned ugly. This thousand-year-old demon was really difficult to deal with.
